_about: Single source of truth for plan facts on every public page (read by ops/seo/plans.py). Change a fact here, then run python ops/seo/prepublish.py, which regenerates the marked regions of index.html and plans.html and fails on any page that disagrees. Sources: plan_limit_for() (migration 030; any paid plan other than kickstart/pro/elite gets 1, which is Solo), PAID_PLANS / ELITE_PLANS and the Free trial length in the backend (migration 042; 3 days = 72 h for trials that start on or after 20 Oct 2026, owner-approved 19 Oct 2026, plus one 2-day extension when the first hunt found nothing; trials started before 20 Oct 2026 keep 7 days and that is stated only in /terms), Whop plans, outreach/00-fact-sheet.md. Check speed comes from check-interval.json, not from here.
_passes: One-time passes (owner-approved 20 Oct 2026): paid once, VAT included, run for 'days' from the purchase, then end. No renewal, nothing to cancel. The 14-day refund applies to the payment. Kept out of 'plans' so the monthly tables stay 5 columns. whop_plan_id 'plan_PENDING_PASS' = no Whop plan yet: check_site.py fails every page that offers its checkout until the real id is here.

extension.when: the hunt found nothing in the first 3 days

free_trial.during: 24/7 with push alerts, like a paid plan
free_trial.after: checked only while the dashboard is open
